description: This file contains a set of unit tests for the EmailMan module within the SuiteCRM project, validating methods like toString, create list/query, email sending, validation, and deletion functionalities.

classes.name: EmailManTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for EmailMan module, testing various functionalities such as object creation, query generation, email validation, and sending.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, sets up global variables, and configures default settings for each test case.

methods.name: testtoString
methods.description: Tests the toString method of EmailMan, verifying output with and without attributes set.

methods.name: testEmailMan
methods.description: Validates the constructor and attributes of the EmailMan bean.

methods.name: testcreate_new_list_query
methods.description: Tests the creation of SQL queries for listing email records with various parameters.

methods.name: testcreate_queue_items_query
methods.description: Tests the generation of SQL queries for queue items with and without parameters.

methods.name: testcreate_list_query
methods.description: Validates the list query generation logic with different input parameters.

methods.name: testget_list_view_data
methods.description: Checks the data structure returned by get_list_view_data method.

methods.name: testset_as_sent
methods.description: Verifies the set_as_sent method executes without exceptions for different delete flags.

methods.name: testcreate_indiv_email
methods.description: Tests creation of individual email and cleans up by marking the email as deleted.

methods.name: testverify_campaign
methods.description: Validates the verify_campaign method with empty input.

methods.name: testsendEmail
methods.description: Ensures sendEmail executes successfully with different related type settings.

methods.name: testvalid_email_address
methods.description: Tests email address validation with empty, invalid, and valid email formats.

methods.name: testis_primary_email_address
methods.description: Checks behavior of is_primary_email_address without email data.

methods.name: testcreate_export_query
methods.description: Validates export query creation with empty and specific conditions.

methods.name: testmark_deleted
methods.description: Ensures mark_deleted method executes without exceptions.

methods.name: testcreate_ref_email
methods.description: Tests creation of reference email and cleanup marking it as deleted.
